name: qbo
description: Operate QuickBooks Online through a signed-in browser (AE cloud browser or local Chrome over CDP).

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-snippets.mjs && npx --yes esbuild@0.24.0 bin/qbo.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/qbo.mjs --banner:js='import { createRequire as __cr } from "node:module"; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);' --log-level=warning && chmod +x dist/qbo.mjs
